localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: There is room for up to approximately 12 RVs in this group site with 6 RV power pedestals. Some of the RV spots may be better suited for smaller RVs and may be difficult for larger RVs to access due to the natural surroundings. All vehicles must remain on the gravel area.  Tenters are able to set up on the gravel or in close proximity to the gravel area.  The group site is surrounded by Ponderosa pine/bunchgrass forest. Each site has a picnic shelter, tables and a large fire pit. The shelter has electric outlets and counter tops for food prep. There is a shared water tap, dish washing station, garbage and recycling bins and flush toilets between the group sites. The area is setback on a terrace above the river and day-use area.  The access road to Group Site 2 runs next to this group site. 8 electrical hookups are available in this group campsite. An extra fee of $8.00 per 30 amp service per night will be collected on site – CASH only please.
